descriptions.zh: ><notice>阿里云提供的OpenAPI属于管控类API，用于管理和查询阿里云服务的相关资源。仅推荐在管控链路集成，消息收发的核心数据链路中严禁依赖OpenAPI实现，否则可能会导致链路产生风险。></notice>
descriptions.en:
><notice>

Alibaba Cloud OpenAPI is a control-plane API. You can use it to manage and query Alibaba Cloud service resources. Do not use OpenAPI for core data links that send and receive messages because this can create threats to your data links.

></notice>
